config.title: AMD TokenFactory Provider
config.baseUrl.desc: AMD TokenFactory OpenAI-compatible API base URL.
config.apiKeyMode.desc: API key usage mode when multiple keys are configured.
config.apiKeyMode.enum.rotation.desc: Rotation: pick the next available key for every request (default).
config.apiKeyMode.enum.sticky.desc: Sticky: keep using the current key until it fails, then switch to the next one.
config.apiKeyRotationStatusCodes.desc: HTTP status codes that trigger switching to the next API key.
config.apiKeyRotationErrorPatterns.desc: Error text patterns (case-insensitive) that trigger switching to the next API key.
config.transientRetryStatusCodes.desc: HTTP status codes treated as transient failures (cooldown, then whole-round automatic retry).
config.exhaustedCooldownMin.desc: Cooldown duration in minutes for keys that hit transient errors (e.g. 429 rate limit).
config.transientRetryTimes.desc: How many times to automatically retry the whole round when all keys are in transient cooldown.
config.maxOutputTokens.desc: Per-request output token budget sent as max_tokens. Increase this if responses get cut off (finish reason: length).
config.debugLogBody.desc: Log request body head and full response text to the AMD TokenFactory output channel for diagnostics. Verbose and may contain conversation content — enable only while debugging.
config.enableAutoModelDiscovery.desc: Discover the model list from the API /models endpoint automatically.
config.maxInputTokensRatio.desc: Ratio of the real context window declared as max input tokens (controls Copilot auto-compaction).
config.temperature.desc: Sampling temperature. Leave null to not send the parameter.
config.top_p.desc: Nucleus sampling top_p. Leave null to not send the parameter.
config.retryEnabled.desc: Enable automatic retry for transient network/HTTP errors.
config.retryIntervalMs.desc: Initial retry interval in milliseconds (exponential backoff).
